72157636003310225.title: Höga kusten
72157636003310225.description: The High Coast (Swedish: Höga kusten) is a part of the coast of Sweden on the Gulf of Bothnia, situated in the municipalities of Kramfors, Härnösand and Örnsköldsvik and notable as a type area for research on post-glacial rebound and eustacy, in which the land rises as the weight of the glaciers melts off of it. This phenomenon was first recognised and studied there; since the last ice age the land has risen 800 m, which accounts for the unusual landscape with tall cliff formations. The High Coast is part of the Swedish/Finnish High Coast/Kvarken Archipelago world heritage site (the High Coast was extended with Finnish Kvarken areas in 2006). (Wikipedia CC:BY-SA). I think you will like the place. Go there! You will not be disappointed.

One year, 33 photographs, 3 different cameras and 2 lenses. Half of them or so are stitched from more than one image.

These images describes my year, from winter in Uppsala, some domestic travels to Lund, Gotland and Scania during the spring and summer. Vacation images from Sardinia. Photos from my  hometown Uppsala and work place Stockholm. Last image is from a couple of minutes before twelve new year's eve.

I hope next year get as good as 2009!
